sentences.sentence: I’d say he’s around 50, but I’m only guessing.
sentences.translation: 我想他50岁左右，不过也只是猜测。

sentences.sentence: What star sign are you? No, let me guess .
sentences.translation: 你是什么星座的？别说，让我来猜猜看。

sentences.sentence: The earthworm is a useful animal. On the ground it is food for other animals. Under the ground, it makes rich soil for fields and gardens.
sentences.translation: 蚯蚓是一种有益的动物。在地面上它是其他动物的食物。在地下，它为田园和花园制造肥沃的土壤。

sentences.sentence: But when genetic characterization of the contents of beetle guts gave some unexpected results, the researchers decided to take a closer look at earthworm DNA.
sentences.translation: 但是，当甲虫背脊骨包容的遗传特性显示出一些意想不到的结果时，这些研究人员决定仔细查明蚯蚓的DNA。

sentences.sentence: Germination is complicated with the bursting forth of a meteor and with the peck of a swallow cracking its egg, and it places on one level the birth of an earthworm and the advent of Socrates.
sentences.translation: 万物的化育是复杂的，有风云雷电诸天象，有破壳而出的乳燕，一条蚯蚓的出生和苏格拉底的来临同属于化育之列。

sentences.sentence: Creativity and uniqueness often depends on how well you hide your sources.
sentences.translation: 创意和独特性往往取决于如何隐藏你的创意来源。

sentences.sentence: This (I hope) will be unique within the scope of the trace, and the combination of thread ID and random number should afford you uniqueness across multiple JVMs.
sentences.translation: 它（我希望如此）在跟踪的范围内将是唯一的，而线程 ID 和随机数的组合应该能够满足跨越多个 JVM 的唯一性。

sentences.sentence: They like five-star hotels and deferential treatment.
sentences.translation: 他们喜欢五星级酒店和谦恭的礼遇。

sentences.sentence: He concluded that the sexual drive was the most powerful shaper of a person's psychology, and that sexuality was present even in infants.
sentences.translation: 他得出的结论是，性冲动是个人心理最有力的塑造者，即使是婴儿，他们也有性欲。

sentences.sentence: Say what you will about Apple, but Steve Jobs’ company is a market shaper, and the iPad is the only tablet that could shove the computing world in a new direction.
sentences.translation: 不管怎么说苹果公司，这个史蒂夫乔布斯的公司都是一个市场塑造者，iPad将是唯一引领计算界新方向的平板电脑。

sentences.sentence: a genial smile

sentences.sentence: Hotels in Tokyo enjoy over 90% occupancy.
sentences.translation: 东京的宾馆入住率高达90%以上。

sentences.sentence: ‘Of course I don’t mind,’ she answered mildly.
sentences.translation: “我当然不介意。”她温和地答道。

sentences.sentence: Near Amsterdam there is an ethnographic museum where one can trace the history of klomps development, to see the fully automated production process of this unique wooden shoes.
sentences.translation: 在阿姆斯特丹附近，有一个人种学博物馆，里面介绍了木屐鞋的发展历史，还能了解这种独特木鞋的整个自动化制作过程。

phrases.translation: 无限大容量母线；无限汇流排

sentences.sentence: The universe is infinite.
sentences.translation: 宇宙是无限的。

sentences.sentence: Employing abrasive machining for the form of the gear and intellective-control carburizing and quenching technology for the surface, the gear is with high intensity, strong tenacity and wearability.
sentences.translation: 齿轮齿形采用磨齿加工，齿面采用智能控制渗碳淬火技术，齿轮的强度高、韧性和耐磨性好。

sentences.sentence: Its slip resistance and durability provide stability and long term wearability .
sentences.translation: 它的滑性和耐久性提供稳定和长期的耐磨性。

sentences.sentence: The bark was dressed with masthead flags only.
sentences.translation: 那条三桅帆船只用桅顶旗装饰。

sentences.sentence: This is where you would setup your company site masthead and navigation.
sentences.translation: 可以在该框架中设置公司站点报头（masthead）和导航。

sentences.sentence: These are therefore sometimes called masthead sloops.
sentences.translation: 因此有时我们也把这类帆船叫做桅顶单桅帆(masthead sloops)。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 435 单元

guess
音标：英 /ges/  美 /ɡɛs/
v. 猜测, 推测
短语：guess what — 猜怎么了；猜猜看；猜怎么着
短语：guess who — 猜猜是谁
短语：guess at — 猜测；估计
短语：at a guess — 凭猜测；推测
短语：by guess — 凭猜测，推测
短语：educated guess — n. 有根据的推测
短语：make a guess — 猜测，猜想
短语：wild guess — 胡乱猜想
短语：anybody's guess — 难以预料；谁也猜不准的事情
例句：I’d say he’s around 50, but I’m only guessing.
我想他50岁左右，不过也只是猜测。
例句：What star sign are you? No, let me guess .
你是什么星座的？别说，让我来猜猜看。

gaze
音标：英 /geɪz/  美 /ɡeɪz/
v. 盯, 凝视
短语：gaze at — 盯住；凝视
短语：at gaze — ◎【纹章学】(鹿或类似鹿的动物)从旁看去似在盯着人看的，侧身正视的
短语：gaze out — 向外注视
例句：Patrick sat gazing into space  (= looking straight in front, not at any particular person or thing ).
帕特里克坐着，茫然地看着前方。

earthworm
音标：英 /'ɜːθwɜːm/  美 /'ɝθwɝm/
n. 蚯蚓
例句：The earthworm is a useful animal. On the ground it is food for other animals. Under the ground, it makes rich soil for fields and gardens.
蚯蚓是一种有益的动物。在地面上它是其他动物的食物。在地下，它为田园和花园制造肥沃的土壤。
例句：But when genetic characterization of the contents of beetle guts gave some unexpected results, the researchers decided to take a closer look at earthworm DNA.
但是，当甲虫背脊骨包容的遗传特性显示出一些意想不到的结果时，这些研究人员决定仔细查明蚯蚓的DNA。
例句：Germination is complicated with the bursting forth of a meteor and with the peck of a swallow cracking its egg, and it places on one level the birth of an earthworm and the advent of Socrates.
万物的化育是复杂的，有风云雷电诸天象，有破壳而出的乳燕，一条蚯蚓的出生和苏格拉底的来临同属于化育之列。

fantastic
音标：英 /fæn'tæstɪk/  美 /fæn'tæstɪk/
adj. 幻想的, 奇异的
短语：fantastic job — 干的太好了；好样的
例句：a fantastic scheme
异想天开的计划

lateral
音标：英 /'læt(ə)r(ə)l/  美 /'lætərəl/
n. 侧部, 支线 a侧面的
短语：lateral displacement — 横向位移，侧向位移；侧方移位
短语：lateral pressure — 侧压；旁压力
短语：lateral stiffness — 横向刚性，横向刚度
短语：lateral load — 横向荷载，横向负荷；冲力
短语：lateral force — 侧向力
短语：lateral movement — 横向运动
短语：amyotrophic lateral sclerosis — 肌萎缩性脊髓侧索硬化症
短语：lateral ventricle — 侧脑室
短语：lateral direction — 横向
短语：lateral stability — 横向稳定性，侧向稳定性；横稳性，侧稳度
短语：lateral acceleration — 侧向加速度；横向加速率
短语：lateral earth pressure — 水平土压；横向土压力；侧向土压力
短语：lateral flow — 侧流；横向流
短语：lateral position — 侧卧位
短语：lateral deflection — [电]旁向偏转
短语：lateral thinking — 横向思维；水平思考
短语：lateral bending — 横向弯曲；侧向弯曲
短语：lateral resolution — 横向分辨率
短语：lateral line — 支线，侧线
短语：lateral support — 横向支承

intimately
音标：英 /'intimitli/  美 /ˈɪntəmɪtlɪ/
adv. 密切地,  亲密地
例句：Maybe your relationships will be your primary focus for a period of life, as well as learning how to cultivate them more intimately and intelligently.
或许生活中的一段时期，你的主要焦点是人际关系，了解怎样聪明地培养人际亲密关系成为了关注点。

nostril
音标：英 /'nɒstr(ə)l/  美 /'nɑstrəl/
n. 鼻孔
例句：The smell of gunpowder filled his nostrils.
火药味灌进他的鼻孔。
例句：the horse’s flaring nostrils
马儿张大的鼻孔

bis
音标：英 /bɪs/  美 /bɪs/
adv. 二度, 二回

uniqueness
音标：英 /ju:'ni:knis/  美 /jʊ'niknɪs/
n. 唯一性, 独特性
短语：uniqueness theorem — 唯一性定理；单值定理
例句：Creativity and uniqueness often depends on how well you hide your sources.
创意和独特性往往取决于如何隐藏你的创意来源。
例句：This (I hope) will be unique within the scope of the trace, and the combination of thread ID and random number should afford you uniqueness across multiple JVMs.
它（我希望如此）在跟踪的范围内将是唯一的，而线程 ID 和随机数的组合应该能够满足跨越多个 JVM 的唯一性。

deferential
音标：英 /defə'renʃ(ə)l/  美 /ˌdefə'rɛnʃl/
adj. 恭敬的, 顺从的
例句：They like five-star hotels and deferential treatment.
他们喜欢五星级酒店和谦恭的礼遇。

shaper
n. 造形者, 塑造者
短语：gear shaper — 插齿机；刨齿机
例句：He concluded that the sexual drive was the most powerful shaper of a person's psychology, and that sexuality was present even in infants.
他得出的结论是，性冲动是个人心理最有力的塑造者，即使是婴儿，他们也有性欲。
例句：Say what you will about Apple, but Steve Jobs’ company is a market shaper, and the iPad is the only tablet that could shove the computing world in a new direction.
不管怎么说苹果公司，这个史蒂夫乔布斯的公司都是一个市场塑造者，iPad将是唯一引领计算界新方向的平板电脑。

genial
音标：英 /'dʒiːnɪəl/  美 /'dʒinɪəl/
adj. 亲切的
例句：a genial smile
亲切的微笑

avocational
n. 娱乐,  消遣

occupancy
音标：英 /'ɒkjəpənsɪ/  美 /'ɑkjəpənsi/
n. 占有
短语：occupancy rate — 居住率；租用率
例句：Hotels in Tokyo enjoy over 90% occupancy.
东京的宾馆入住率高达90%以上。

mildly
音标：英 /'maɪldlɪ/  美 /'maɪldli/
adv. 温和地, 适度地
短语：put it mildly — ◎[常作插入语]说得婉转些
例句：‘Of course I don’t mind,’ she answered mildly.
“我当然不介意。”她温和地答道。

bundle
音标：英 /'bʌnd(ə)l/  美 /'bʌndl/
n. 捆v捆扎
例句：a small bundle containing mostly clothing
一个小包袱，里面主要是衣服

ethnographic
音标：英 /,eθnə'ɡræfɪk/  美 /,eθnə'ɡræfik/
adj. 民族志学的,  人种志学的
例句：Near Amsterdam there is an ethnographic museum where one can trace the history of klomps development, to see the fully automated production process of this unique wooden shoes.
在阿姆斯特丹附近，有一个人种学博物馆，里面介绍了木屐鞋的发展历史，还能了解这种独特木鞋的整个自动化制作过程。

infinite
音标：英 /'ɪnfɪnət/  美 /'ɪnfɪnət/
adj. 无限的，无穷的
短语：infinite loop — 无限循环
短语：infinite space — 无限空间
短语：infinite variety — 多种多样
短语：infinite bus — 无限大容量母线；无限汇流排
短语：infinite dimensional — 无限维的
短语：infinite medium — 无限介质，无限媒质
短语：infinite distance — 无限远距离，无穷远
例句：The universe is infinite.
宇宙是无限的。

wearability
n. 耐磨性, 磨损性
例句：Employing abrasive machining for the form of the gear and intellective-control carburizing and quenching technology for the surface, the gear is with high intensity, strong tenacity and wearability.
齿轮齿形采用磨齿加工，齿面采用智能控制渗碳淬火技术，齿轮的强度高、韧性和耐磨性好。
例句：Its slip resistance and durability provide stability and long term wearability .
它的滑性和耐久性提供稳定和长期的耐磨性。

masthead
音标：英 /'mɑːsthed/  美 /'mæsthɛd/
n. 桅顶, 报头
例句：The bark was dressed with masthead flags only.
那条三桅帆船只用桅顶旗装饰。
例句：This is where you would setup your company site masthead and navigation.
可以在该框架中设置公司站点报头（masthead）和导航。
例句：These are therefore sometimes called masthead sloops.
因此有时我们也把这类帆船叫做桅顶单桅帆(masthead sloops)。
